problem_units.macro_problem_name: Evidence Sufficiency, Uncertainty, and Abstention and Shortcut Bias and Spurious Context Dependence
problem_units.micro_problem_name: NMS-based deterministic inference forces hard segment selection under missing visual evidence
problem_units.micro_problem_question: How can MR avoid overconfident temporal selection when query-required evidence is missing or incomplete?
problem_units.failure_mode: NMS still selects the most probable segment although the model lacks evidence for the queried action.
problem_units.root_cause: Deterministic MR cannot represent evidence insufficiency or abstain on hard moments.
problem_units.why_existing_methods_fail: Cross-modal alignment improvements do not prevent deterministic post-processing from forcing a segment.
problem_units.affected_scenario: The query asks when the woman is cooking, but some frames do not contain the woman.

problem_units.macro_problem_name: Evidence Sufficiency, Uncertainty, and Abstention and Shortcut Bias and Spurious Context Dependence
problem_units.micro_problem_name: Vanilla DER miscalibrates uncertainty under multimodal evidence fusion
problem_units.micro_problem_question: How can DER be adapted when evidence must be fused from video and text?
problem_units.failure_mode: Higher-error predictions may receive lower uncertainty while accurate samples receive higher uncertainty.
problem_units.root_cause: Vanilla DER relies on a heuristic regularizer and does not account for visual-text modality imbalance.
problem_units.why_existing_methods_fail: Simple multimodal concatenation and evidence suppression misalign uncertainty with prediction error.

evidence.quote: Additionally, DER faces counterintuitive uncertainty issues: higher-error predictions can receive lower uncertainty due to limitations in vanilla DER’s regularizer.
